rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for choosing or picking one or more options.

example.jyutping: nei5 gaan2 bin1 bun2 syu1 dou1 dak1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something being excellent or high-quality.

example.english: The pineapple buns here are really select.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲菠蘿包真係靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 dik1 bo1 lo4 baau1 zan1 hai6 leng3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a premium, upscale, or exclusive quality rather than simply being good.

example.english: They had dinner at a select restaurant.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺一間高級餐廳食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gou1 kap1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6
